final: WITH regional AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), above_mean AS (SELECT * FROM regional WHERE avg_amount > (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM regional)) SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_regional_average, AVG(transaction_count) AS mean_transaction_count, AVG(avg_amount - (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM regional)) AS mean_excess_over_cross_region_mean FROM above_mean
